pages.text: Set a $(item)Scanner$() beside the computer (or on its data wire). Right click it to lift the lid: a map, a photo or a book goes on the glass, paper in the tray, and prints come out in the output tray.$(br2)In the shell's Files list, F6 scans what is on the glass into a file: a picture into an .IMG, a book into a .TXT. F5 prints the selected file.

Pictures print on $(item)Color Photo Paper$() as a color photo, on an empty map as a plain color $(item)Printout$(), or on $(item)Photo Paper$() in black and white. Text prints as a written book, a sheet of paper a page.$(br2)Take each print out before the next, or the scanner jams. Without a scanner the computer does everything else.
Flatbed glass on top, ink underneath.
